notes.title: PixElated Adventures 2024 by Brave At Night
notes.notes:
Li'l Red is partaking in the PixElated Adventures festival which showcases various pixel art games and offers discounted prices as well. This sale lasts from July 29th through August 5th of 2024.

notes.title: New Web Manual for Li'l Red
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704812/3d7894e047721b82bbbcdf07c4fd04707717f255.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704812/83690091329c053e151b9e26fe35aaa244d413b3.png[/img][/url]
The Steam page for Li'l Red now comes with a web manual which adds visuals for the text descriptions of the game's moves. There are also visuals for 3 of the game's filters.

The in-game timer has been updated to not roll back to the last recorded time once Lyra starts over at a checkpoint.

notes.title: New Combo System for Li'l Red
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704812/661e308c59596014c75a4d226da5318d3908aafa.png[/img]
In exchange for the previous grading system that had an exact 100 points to get, the new grading system places a greater focus on defeating enemies whilst avoiding damage that would deduct 4 combo points apiece.

Slope Jumps have also received a new tutorial within area 2 (and the Steam page) as well as a new feature which lets Lyra conserve momentum by jumping after landing from a Slope Jump.
